request_type.label: 1. Type
request_type.why: Every approved ARL document (25/25, own and colleague) is a Transfer (radio value 01); Increase (02, 30% cap) and New Account (03) exist on the form but have no precedent, so they need explicit confirmation.

source_account.label: 5. Transfer Item: Source
source_account.why: Which account gives up budget depends on the live Available balance (team_budget_detail_list.php), not on precedent; sources vary across all 25 docs.

target_account.label: 5. Transfer Item: Target
target_account.why: The target is the account the department books this kind of expense to, shown as '[ <6-digit code>] <name>'; the only expense-to-account rule with enough support is in the conditional (registration fee -> 410306).

amount1.label: 5. Transfer Item: Amount
amount1.why: The shortfall of this case; never compared to precedent.

control_no.label: 6. Control No
control_no.why: 8-digit number that increases with draft date across all writers (25004166 .. 26004428), so it looks issued per document rather than chosen; origin unconfirmed.

contents_data.label: Description
contents_data.why: One short English sentence saying what the moved budget is for (e.g. 'Budget transfer for a domestic business trip'); max_len is the colleagues' 75th percentile (77.75 -> 78, n=20). The user's latest (109 chars) and oldest (162 chars, two lines) run longer than department practice.

retention.label: Saving years
retention.why: An older template claims 5 years, but document_view does not show which option was selected, so no rule could be confirmed.

conditional.why: Conference registration fees are booked to 410306; a transfer that funds one must target it.
